scenes.title: The hook
scenes.text: Shopping agents are great at finding a cheap price. But a cheap price is useless if it is for the wrong product.
caps: Shopping agents are great at finding a cheap price.
But a cheap price is useless if it is for the wrong product.

scenes.title: The hook
scenes.text: SKUdesk puts one gate in front of every number: is this listing provably the same item? If nothing is, the answer is no.
caps: SKUdesk puts one gate in front of every number:
is this listing provably the same item? If nothing is, the answer is no.

scenes.title: Step 1 · A live check
scenes.text: Here is a live check on Google Cloud. SKUdesk searches Google Shopping, and Gemini judges every listing. Green is the identical product, red is something else, amber is not provable.
caps: A live check on Google Cloud. SKUdesk searches Google Shopping, and Gemini judges every listing.
Green is the identical product, red is something else, amber is not provable.

scenes.title: Step 1 · A live check
scenes.text: It answers in plain terms: what to buy, what a resale would keep, and whether any gap survives every cost.
caps: It answers in plain terms: what to buy, what a resale would keep,
and whether any gap survives every cost.

scenes.title: Step 1 · A live check
scenes.text: The price ladder shows every offer that matched, and each one carries the brand and set number Gemini quoted from the listing, which code verifies.
caps: The price ladder shows every offer that matched,
and each carries the brand and set number Gemini quoted, which code verifies.

scenes.title: Step 2 · A person decides
scenes.text: Nothing is bought without a person. The agent files a proposal, and only the person who ran the check, or the owner, can approve it.
caps: Nothing is bought without a person. The agent files a proposal,
and only the person who ran the check, or the owner, can approve it.

scenes.title: Step 2 · A person decides
scenes.text: For a LEGO Titanic, seven of thirty listings pass. Two more match the set but are priced at eleven and nineteen dollars, so they are set aside as bad data. The cheapest real offer loses money on resale. The answer is no arbitrage.
caps: LEGO Titanic: seven of thirty listings pass. Two more match the set
but sit at eleven and nineteen dollars, so they are set aside as bad data.
The cheapest real offer loses money on resale. The answer is no arbitrage.

scenes.title: Step 3 · Replay
scenes.text: Every check can be replayed line by line: the search, each verdict, the evidence code verified, and the proposal it filed. A decision is never a black box.
caps: Every check can be replayed line by line: the search, each verdict,
the evidence code verified, and the proposal it filed.

scenes.title: Step 4 · The offer market
scenes.text: The offer market tracks each product's ladder of identical offers. A daily Cloud Scheduler scan keeps the price history growing.
caps: The offer market tracks each product's ladder of identical offers.
A daily Cloud Scheduler scan keeps the price history growing.

scenes.title: Step 5 · Evidence
scenes.text: Gemini is not simply trusted. It must quote the brand and set number from both listings, and code checks that the quotes are really there. A claim it cannot back up never passes.
caps: Gemini is not simply trusted. It must quote the brand and set number,
and code checks the quotes are really there. A claim it cannot back up never passes.

scenes.title: Step 5 · Evidence
scenes.text: Across forty-three hand-labelled pairs against the real model, zero wrong matches passed. The limits of that test are written on the page.
caps: Across forty-three hand-labelled pairs against the real model,
zero wrong matches passed. The limits of that test are on the page.

scenes.title: Step 6 · Limits and control
scenes.text: The owner holds the controls: a per-buy limit, a margin floor, and a kill switch that stops scans, new proposals and approvals. They need a key, and every change goes in the audit log.
caps: The owner holds the controls: a per-buy limit, a margin floor,
and a kill switch that stops scans, proposals and approvals. Every change is logged.

scenes.title: Step 6 · Limits and control
scenes.text: A what-if simulator runs the same economics as a real check, so you can test any price against the current limits.
caps: A what-if simulator runs the same economics as a real check,
so you can test any price against the current limits.

scenes.title: Built on Google Cloud
scenes.text: It runs on Cloud Run with Firestore, Cloud Scheduler and Secret Manager, under a strict content policy, with rate limits and a monthly search budget.
caps: It runs on Cloud Run with Firestore, Cloud Scheduler and Secret Manager,
under a strict content policy, with rate limits and a search budget.

scenes.title: Try it
scenes.text: SKUdesk. If nothing is provably the same, it says no.
